title: Writing Code
statementMd:
Programmers working on a large project have just received a task to write exactly $*m*$ lines of code. There are $*n*$ programmers working on a project, the $*i*$-th of them makes exactly $*a*_{*i*}$ bugs in every line of code that he writes.

Let's call a sequence of non-negative integers $*v*_{1}, *v*_{2}, ..., *v*_{*n*}$ a *plan*, if $*v*_{1} + *v*_{2} + ... + *v*_{*n*} = *m*$. The programmers follow the plan like that: in the beginning the first programmer writes the first $*v*_{1}$ lines of the given task, then the second programmer writes $*v*_{2}$ more lines of the given task, and so on. In the end, the last programmer writes the remaining lines of the code. Let's call a plan *good*, if all the written lines of the task contain at most $*b*$ bugs in total.

Your task is to determine how many distinct *good* plans are there. As the number of plans can be large, print the remainder of this number modulo given positive integer $*mod*$.

## Input

The first line contains four integers $*n*$, $*m*$, $*b*$, $*mod*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 500$, $0 ≤ *b* ≤ 500$; $1 ≤ *mod* ≤ 10^{9} + 7$) — the number of programmers, the number of lines of code in the task, the maximum total number of bugs respectively and the modulo you should use when printing the answer.

The next line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 500$) — the number of bugs per line for each programmer.

## Output

Print a single integer — the answer to the problem modulo $*mod*$.
statementZhMd:
大型项目中的程序员刚刚接到任务，需要编写恰好 $*m*$ 行代码。项目中有 $*n*$ 名程序员，其中第 $*i*$ 名程序员编写的每一行代码恰好会产生 $*a*_{*i*}$ 个漏洞。

如果一个由非负整数组成的序列 $*v*_{1}, *v*_{2}, ..., *v*_{*n*}$ 满足 $*v*_{1} + *v*_{2} + ... + *v*_{*n*} = *m*$，则称其为一个*方案*。程序员按照如下方式执行方案：首先由第一名程序员编写任务中的前 $*v*_{1}$ 行代码，然后由第二名程序员再编写 $*v*_{2}$ 行，依此类推。最后由最后一名程序员编写剩余的代码行。如果任务中编写的所有代码总共至多包含 $*b*$ 个漏洞，则称该方案是*优秀的*。

你的任务是确定有多少个不同的*优秀方案*。由于方案数量可能很大，请输出该数量除以给定正整数 $*mod*$ 所得的余数。

## 输入格式

第一行包含四个整数 $*n*, *m*, *b*, *mod*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 500$，$0 ≤ *b* ≤ 500$；$1 ≤ *mod* ≤ 10^{9} + 7$）——分别表示程序员的数量、任务中的代码行数、允许的漏洞总数上限以及输出答案时使用的模数。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个用空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 500$）——每名程序员每行代码产生的漏洞数。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——该问题的答案对 $*mod*$ 取模后的结果。
